title: Interpretation of Scripture
definition: Interpretation of Scripture is the faithful work of understanding what God's Word means according to its context, wording, genre, and place in the whole Bible.
summary: Faithful interpretation seeks the meaning God gave in the text rather than forcing personal ideas into it.
christFocus: Jesus interpreted Scripture as God's unified testimony fulfilled in Himself.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Interpretation matters because Scripture must be understood before it is applied. A verse lifted from context can be made to say what God never intended. Faithful interpretation listens carefully to the text.

Believers interpret Scripture by paying attention to words, grammar, context, genre, covenant setting, and the whole counsel of God. The goal is not cleverness but faithfulness.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many harmful teachings begin with misused Scripture. Interpretation matters because mishandling the Bible can confuse believers, justify sin, and distort the Gospel.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Slow down when reading Scripture. Ask what the passage meant in context before asking how it applies. Compare Scripture with Scripture and remain humble enough to be corrected by the text.
